snippet.title: Arcadia Fallen II - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Arcadia Fallen II is now available on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch™!

Outside the thick walls of your school, a storm is brewing. Feelings of mistrust in mages have been growing for years, whipped up by politicians with vested interests, and now the Academy itself is in the spotlight. What will you do when the storm sweeps through your school?

As you uncover the story of Arcadia Fallen II, you will decide how you respond to the people around you and the events that unfold. Tone labels help you avoid unexpected consequences, and choices with significant impact on the story are highlighted. But no matter what you decide to do, there are no “wrong” choices and no dead ends. Only you can find the path that is right for you.

Arcadia Fallen II has expanded on the character creator from the first game and players can select whom of their two childhood friends they share a dorm room with, and what magical discipline they major in. Your choice will affect your character's upbringing, what locations they are familiar with, and what skills they bring to the team. This and more will influence puzzles throughout the game and challenge the player in different ways depending on the choices they make in each playthrough.

Compared to the first game, the story of Arcadia Fallen II is more than 50% longer, with many more locations, characters, cut-in visuals, and twice the amount of recorded voice lines. Suffice it to say, if you enjoyed the first game, Arcadia Fallen II has a whole lot more of it to offer.
